answer: To stop automated swarms from flooding the market with fake clones, the system tracks credibility across a sprawling trust atlas. In this setup, a newly created agent, such as a specialized trade bot or a lotus node, gains status only when established peers stake their own reputations to vouch for it over time. This dense reef of mutual attestations effectively locks out sybil attackers, as unvouched identities cannot participate without trusted sponsors risking their standing.
